recipe.name: Vegetarian Tomato Rice
recipe.description: Simple vegetarian tomato rice recipe for 2 servings

steps.title: Rinse rice
steps.text: Rinse 150g rice in cold water until water runs clear

steps.title: Sauté onion
steps.text: Heat 15ml oil in pan, add 1 small onion, sauté until soft

steps.title: Chop tomato
steps.text: Finely chop 1 medium tomato into small pieces

steps.title: Add tomato
steps.text: Add chopped tomato to pan with onion, cook for 2 minutes

steps.title: Combine rice and water
steps.text: Add 150g rice and 150ml water to pan, stir gently

steps.title: Cook rice
steps.text: Bring to boil, then reduce heat to low, cover and cook for 15 minutes

recipe.tip: Serve with a side of fresh herbs for extra flavor
